description: iconify-component declared, no id in the evidence, network and crop tools blocked: /identify-icon reports no Iconify id, falls back to a ToDo for the crop or, when the screenshot does not show the control, a NEEDS CONFIRMATION marker, and edits no page.
setup: printf -- '- **Icon rendering:** `iconify-component`\n' >> CLAUDE.md && mkdir -p portal/payments/archive-payment/.assets && echo iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mNkYAAAAAYAAjCB0C8AAAAASUVORK5CYII= | base64 --decode > portal/payments/archive-payment/.assets/payments-page.png && git add -A && git commit -q -m 'Case setup'
prompt: /{plugin}:identify-icon portal/payments/archive-payment/.assets/payments-page.png the three-dots button at the end of each payment row

assertions.name: a ToDo or a NEEDS CONFIRMATION marker in place of an id (the fixture screenshot is 1×1, so it may not show the control)
no Iconify id anywhere in the output
